ask: Do the two back translation rows look right?
problem: Bezily's group thought a back translation needs a peer review, because the screen listed them side by side.
found: The Standard flow lists the peer check and back translation together, and a made back translation said "looks good" though no one had checked it.
changed: Back translation now has two rows: make it, then check it. A made one says "made". The check row says "checked" once done.
why: You chose two rows with the flows unchanged. The rows use the same cards as the other rows. They say nothing about a peer review.
touches: Only the passage screen's list. Flows, checks and the back translation screen are unchanged. New words added in all languages.
